heroV4.headline: Landscape plans shaped around your property and how you live outside.
heroV4.body:
Professional Turf & Landscape has spent more than 30 years helping homeowners across Vancouver, Ridgefield, Camas, Battle Ground, and Clark County turn vague backyard ideas into clear, buildable plans.

We start with how you want to use the space, whether that is entertaining, play areas, privacy, or curb appeal, then layer in grading, planting beds, circulation, and the hardscape and water features that tie it together. One team handles design through installation so timelines stay coherent and the finished yard feels intentional, not pieced together.

heroV4.headline: A thick, healthy lawn you can enjoy week after week.
heroV4.body:
From routine mowing to fertilization, aeration, and seasonal treatments, our crew keeps turf looking even and green through Clark County’s wet winters and dry summers.

Whether you need dependable maintenance on an established lawn or help recovering tired turf after construction, we tailor a program to your property, not a one-size-fits-all spray schedule. Don and the team have cared for Southwest Washington landscapes for decades; we show up when we say we will and leave the yard cleaner than we found it.

heroV4.headline: Patios, walls, and outdoor structure built for decades of use.
heroV4.body:
Hardscaping is the backbone of how you move through and use your yard, walkways that drain correctly, patios that stay level, retaining walls that hold grade, and steps that feel safe in every season.

Professional Turf & Landscape designs and builds hardscape that complements your home and the rest of the landscape. We manage excavation, base prep, and finishes so the project looks sharp on day one and holds up to Clark County weather. Tell us about the spaces you want to add or replace; we will walk the site and put together a straightforward estimate.

heroV4.eyebrow: Outdoor Living & Water · Clark County, WA
heroV4.headline: Outdoor kitchens, gathering spaces, and water features you will use most of the year.
heroV4.body:
The best Clark County backyards work for more than a few sunny weekends, covered cooking areas, fire features, ponds, and waterfalls extend how often you are outside and how guests experience your home.

Our team builds outdoor kitchens, patios for hosting, and water features that become the focal point of the yard, with lighting and planting to finish the scene. If you have been dreaming about a space like the covered patios and outdoor kitchens our clients describe in their reviews, start here, we will help you scope something that fits your budget and how you actually live.
